robots_txt.draft:
# robots.txt for www.example.com
# Written 2026-10-30. AI crawler list checked 2026-10-30.

# Everyone: keep the app, API, internal search and staging copies out.
User-agent: *
Disallow: /app/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /search
Disallow: /templates-staging/

# Bing honours Crawl-delay; kept at the owner's request. A named group ignores '*', so the private paths repeat.
User-agent: Bingbot
Crawl-delay: 10
Disallow: /app/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /search
Disallow: /templates-staging/

# Model training: blocked (owner policy).
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
User-agent: CCBot
User-agent: Meta-ExternalAgent
Disallow: /

# AI search index: allowed, with the same private paths as everyone.
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
User-agent: PerplexityBot
Disallow: /app/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /search
Disallow: /templates-staging/

# User fetch: allowed, with the same private paths as everyone.
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: Claude-User
User-agent: Perplexity-User
Disallow: /app/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /search
Disallow: /templates-staging/

Sitemap: https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml

llms_txt.content:
# Example Booking Software

> Example Booking Software is online booking, reminders and payments for salons, clinics, studios and personal trainers. It is for owners and front-desk managers of small service businesses with 1 to 20 staff, mostly in the US, UK and Canada.

## Product

- [Online booking software for small businesses](https://www.example.com/): Online booking, reminders and payments for salons, clinics, studios and personal trainers.
- [Pricing](https://www.example.com/pricing/): Monthly plans by team size, with what each plan includes.
- [Online booking page](https://www.example.com/features/online-booking/): A booking page clients use to pick a service, staff member and time.
- [Automatic SMS and email reminders](https://www.example.com/features/reminders/): Automatic SMS and email reminders that cut no-shows.
- [Deposits and online payments](https://www.example.com/features/payments/): Take deposits and full payments when clients book.
- [Two-way calendar sync](https://www.example.com/features/calendar-sync/): Two-way sync with Google, Outlook and Apple calendars.
- [Integrations](https://www.example.com/integrations/): The calendars, payment and marketing tools it connects to.

## Who it's for

- [Booking software for salons](https://www.example.com/industries/salons/): How salons use online booking for stylists, services and deposits.
- [Appointment scheduling for clinics](https://www.example.com/industries/clinics/): Appointment scheduling, intake and reminders for small clinics.
- [Class booking for studios and trainers](https://www.example.com/industries/fitness/): Class and session booking for studios and personal trainers.

## Help

- [Getting started](https://www.example.com/help/getting-started/): Set up services, staff, hours and the booking page in the first hour.
- [Set up calendar sync](https://www.example.com/help/calendar-sync-setup/): Connect a calendar and fix sync conflicts.

## Guides

- [How to reduce no-shows: 9 tactics that work](https://www.example.com/blog/reduce-no-shows/): Nine tactics that cut no-shows, with reminder timing and deposit rules.
- [Appointment reminder text templates](https://www.example.com/blog/appointment-reminder-templates/): Copy-ready SMS and email reminder templates.
- [Cancellation policy template](https://www.example.com/templates/cancellation-policy/): A cancellation policy template to adapt and publish.
- [12 salon booking tips to fill your calendar](https://www.example.com/blog/salon-booking-tips/): Twelve ways salons fill gaps in the calendar.

## Optional

- [How to write a deposit policy clients accept](https://www.example.com/blog/deposit-policy/): How to set and word a deposit policy clients accept.
- [How to choose a scheduling app](https://www.example.com/blog/scheduling-app-comparison/): What to compare when choosing a scheduling app.
- [Front desk checklist for small clinics](https://www.example.com/blog/front-desk-checklist/): A daily front desk checklist for small clinics.

llms_txt.plain_truth: Google says AI Overviews and AI Mode need no llms.txt. The file costs little and some assistants and coding agents read it; it is not access control and no engine documents it as a ranking factor.

how_to_ship: Put robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt in the Next.js public folder (or generate the first two from app/robots.ts and app/sitemap.ts), then deploy.
Open https://www.example.com/robots.txt and https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml after the deploy and check they match these files.
Submit the sitemap in Search Console. Bing can be told through this skill after you confirm (submit_sitemap).
Run this skill again in a week to read lastDownloaded and any sitemap errors.
unknowns: ChatGPT-User and Perplexity-User may fetch pages even where robots.txt says no; only a firewall rule on their published IP ranges enforces a block. The owner allows them, so nothing to do.
llms-full.txt was not requested, so it was not written.
